title: Positive-degree affine-open Čech derived evaluation
statement: Let $X$ be a separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $i:X_{Zar}\to X_{et}$ be a cover-preserving finite-limit-preserving functor [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] whose composite with forgetting to schemes over $X$ is the open-subscheme restriction functor; assume $i(X)$ is terminal. Let $U_j$ be a finite affine open cover of $X$, and $G$ an additive etale sheaf with coefficients in $\mathrm{Ab}_{u+1}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], whose sheaf category has injective resolutions. Assume that $R^q\mathrm{ev}_W(G)=0$ for every affine etale $X$-scheme $W$ and every $q>0$. Then for every positive degree $q=n+1$, $R^q\mathrm{ev}_{i(X)}(G)$ is isomorphic as an additive group to the degree-$q$ homology of $C^\bullet(U,i^*G)$ [def-weil-pbc-cech-complex]. Here $i^*G$ is the section presheaf $W\mapsto G(i(W))$, and derived evaluation means the right-derived functor of sheaf evaluation at that object.

source.place: Lemma 03AZ, Cech-to-cohomology spectral sequence, acyclic-cover specialization; Theorem 03P2 separated-case proof. Worker-written derived-evaluation formulation.

proof.text: Choose the actual Mathlib injective resolution I of G and construct its open Čech double complex D. Apply the existing first-quadrant double-complex spectral-sequence theorem to get E, E2^(p,q) ≅ H^p_I H^q_II(D), and the explicit finite abutment filtration on homology of Tot D.

Use the proved affine column theorem: the zero vertical-homology row is the sections Čech complex, and all terms of every positive row are zero. Their horizontal homology is therefore zero. Transport this vanishing through the E2 identifications.

Apply the proved natural-index bottom-row collapse theorem. In degree n+1 compose its isomorphism with E2^(n+1,0) ≅ H^(n+1) of the zero row, and with homology of the zero-row complex comparison. The inverse total-resolution comparison identifies the source with derived evaluation. The full composition is written in Lean and the existing signature stays unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Actual injective-resolution double complex; affine column calculation and finite row collapse proved in Lean; total augmentation is the sole new deferred step.

    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.IsSeparated]
    (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    (hi : i ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X = X.restrictFunctor)
    (hc : CoverPreserving (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology i)
    [PreservesFiniteLimits i] (ht : IsTerminal (i.obj ⊤))
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ j, IsAffineOpen (U j)) (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    [HasInjectiveResolutions (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    (hvan : ∀ (W : X.Etale), IsAffine W.left → ∀ (q : ℕ), 0 < q →
      IsZero (((sheafToPresheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
        (CategoryTheory.evaluation X.Etaleᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (op W)).rightDerived q).obj G))
    (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty ((((sheafToPresheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
      (CategoryTheory.evaluation X.Etaleᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (op (i.obj ⊤))).rightDerived (n + 1)).obj G)
        ≅ ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj (i.op ⋙ G.obj)).homology (n + 1))
